summary: Since round 2, AppConversations makes two changes. It takes the reply only from this turn's messages and treats any model error as a failure, so a failed request can no longer resurface an earlier answer. It also stores a turn longer than the 24-message window as only its question and final text answer, so later requests stay valid. A new temp test covers both changes, including the stored shape, history output, a failed turn that is not saved, and a valid next request. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or exempt with an acceptable reason, and no findings remain.
